boundary: Publisher-verified measured-study evidence. These records support mechanism review but do not increment canonical measured-dataset or raw-sample counts unless a source dataset is separately rights-cleared, retrieved, fingerprinted and profiled.

entries.title: A physics-consistent data-driven framework for cross-material pressure and quality prediction
entries.dataAccess: article evidence; no open raw dataset confirmed in this review
entries.limitation: Cross-material mappings are specific to the tested PS/PC materials, mould, sensors and process window.

entries.title: Pressure-curve-based stability analysis for micro-injection molding of ultra-thin polymer components
entries.publisher: Springer Nature / Journal of Polymer Research
experimentalEvidence: end-of-flow signal correlated with complete filling
entries.dataAccess: data available from corresponding author on reasonable request; supplementary material reported
entries.limitation: Ultra-thin micro-component geometry and tested process window are specialised.

entries.title: Real-time product weight estimation based on internal pressure monitoring in injection molding
experimentalEvidence: gate freeze-off measured at 4 s for ABS and 7 s for PP under tested conditions
entries.dataAccess: article tables/figures; no open raw dataset confirmed in this review
entries.limitation: Freeze times and weight-pressure relationships are material, gate, runner, nozzle and process specific and must never become universal recipes.

entries.title: An Investigation to Reduce the Effect of Moisture on Injection-Molded Parts through Optimization of Plasticization Parameters
entries.dataAccess: open article with measured DOE tables/figures; no separate raw dataset confirmed
entries.limitation: The study explores an optimisation strategy and does not justify bypassing supplier drying requirements for other grades or applications.

entries.title: Study of the Influence of the Reprocessing Cycles on the Final Properties of Polylactide Pieces Obtained by Injection Molding
entries.limitation: PLA-specific reprocessing history; results do not transfer quantitatively to PP, PET, PA or other grades.

entries.title: Effects of Variation in Process Parameters on Cavity Pressure and Mechanical Strength of Molded Parts in LSR Injection Molding
entries.publisher: Korean Society of Manufacturing Technology Engineers
entries.dataAccess: article evidence; no open raw dataset confirmed
entries.limitation: LSR formulation, cure chemistry, vent geometry and tested tool are application specific.

entries.title: Novel approach to characterize the cross-linking effect of liquid silicone rubber via cavity pressure analysis during injection molding
entries.publisher: Wiley / Journal of Applied Polymer Science
entries.dataAccess: open article; no separate raw dataset confirmed
entries.limitation: Supports LSR cure-pressure mechanism, not universal cure-time or pressure settings.

entries.title: Effects of Processing Method and Parameters on the Wall Thickness of Gas-Projectile-Assisted Injection Molding Pipes
entries.dataAccess: open article with measured experimental results
entries.limitation: Gas/projectile-assisted pipe geometry is a specialist family and must not be merged with ordinary injection moulding recipes.

entries.title: Experimental and Numerical Investigation of the Effect of Process Conditions on Residual Wall Thickness and Cooling and Surface Characteristics of Water-Assisted Injection Molded Hollow Products
entries.publisher: Wiley / Advances in Materials Science and Engineering
entries.limitation: WAIM has distinct fluid/phase-change physics and should remain separate from GAIM and G-PAIM.

entries.title: Liquid Silicone Rubber Headlamp Lens Injection Molding Process Optimization Based on Tie Bar Elongation and NSGA III
entries.dataAccess: open article with explicit measured table values
entries.limitation: Optical-headlamp LSR application and tested mould/process conditions are specific.

reviewImpact.rule: Promotion still requires the canonical registry's independence, measured-signal, physical-outcome, experimental-context and limitation checks.
